pages.text: $(bold)Line Infantry Musket$()$(br2)The standard military long arm of the realm. Features a reinforced barrel and full shoulder stock, dealing devastating kinetic trauma (40–55 damage).$(br2)$(c)Requires powered Create Mechanical Crafters.$() Standard crafting benches cannot withstand the assembly forces.

$(bold)Mechanical Crafter Grid (3x3)$()$(br2)B B R$(br)M W S$(br)T I P$(br2)$(bold)Legend:$()$(br)B: Barrel Band$(br)R: Rifle Barrel$(br)M: Flintlock Mechanism$(br)W: Rifle Stock$(br)S: Gun Screws$(br)T: Ramrod$(br)I: Tempered Gun Steel$(br)P: Precision Mechanism

$(bold)Assembly Instructions$()$(br2)1. Mount a full 3x3 array (9 Crafters).$(br)2. Connect rotational kinetic power (min 16 RPM).$(br)3. Wrench crafter arrows converging on the output.$(br)4. Insert all 9 precision parts.$(br2)Yields one finished FK15 Musket ready for 16.5mm ammunition.
